exposure: Nonreassuring fetal status (NRFS) during trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: 17,740 women undergoing TOLAC, with 1516 requiring repeat cesarean due to NRFS
finding: Women attempting TOLAC who require repeat cesarean for NRFS are at increased risk of uterine rupture, uterine dehiscence, low 5-minute Apgar score, and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
